name: chatgpt-accents-for-all
description: Browser extension that lets you pick any accent color for ChatGPT.

scripts.zip: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a dist -n chatgpt-accents-chrome-{version}.zip -o && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a dist -n chatgpt-accents-firefox-{version}.zip -o
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
